# FG-REVIEW-0013

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 403 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `the_author_cannot_approve_their_own_merge_request` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 自分のマージリクエストは承認できません。ほかのレビュアーに承認を依頼してください。
- en: You cannot approve your own merge request. Ask another reviewer to approve it.
- id: Anda tidak dapat menyetujui merge request Anda sendiri. Minta peninjau lain untuk menyetujuinya.

## 原因 (cause)

The author of a merge request asked to approve it (ADR-0024 §8.3, §12; ADR-0017 §2.6). authorize() refuses `MergeRequestApprove` when the caller is the author, administrators included (no exception). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `action=MergeRequestApprove`, `reason=self_approval` and the request_id; the merge request's author is the caller (SELECT author_id FROM forge.merge_requests WHERE project_id = <project_id> AND iid = <iid>).

## 対処 (fix)

Ask another Developer (or higher) of the project to approve. A committer's approval is accepted but not counted (`uncounted_reason=committer`, runbook merge-blocked).
